skills.title: Agent Mail - Your Agent Gets Its Own Inbox (you own it)
skills.description: Agent Mail (bring-your-own, user-owned): give the agent its OWN dedicated email inbox that the USER owns. The user creates a brand-new free email for the agent (Gmail or Outlook recommended), turns on 2-step, mints an app password, and connects it; the credential lives encrypted only on that user's runner and the operator holds nothing. Connect is verified with a real IMAP + SMTP login and finishes by sending a proof test message. Prefer over exposing the user's personal mailbox.
activation_phrases: set up email for my agent
